title: Accounts are in, waiting for a server
thisBuild: Everything for accounts is now in the app: messes online, two people in one mess, live edits, share links, History, reporting, delete account and the Vault. None of it shows until the Supabase server is set up, so the app looks the same as the last build.
New for later: when one of your messes changes on two of your own phones, a banner asks Merge, Keep this phone's, or Keep both.
Everything from your bug video is still here: stutter rates, the new Settings, the tighter loop strip, Tempo drop-down, Mixer, Auto trim and Auto sample.
watch: Play a few loops and record a take: everything should work exactly as in the last build.
If anything acts differently from the last build, send a bug note: that points at the accounts code.
limits: No account screens yet: they appear once the server exists.
Mixer levels are per sound: two pads with the same sound move together.
